name: Maison Carrée de Nîmes
elevationDatum: Rigid local exterior foundation plane y=0; metres +X east, +Y up, +Z south. Mapped rotation baked once. No sea-level, DEM or Mercator scaling.
note: Raised Roman temple with six free-standing front Corinthian columns, a deep open pronaos, thirty fluted free/engaged shafts, a single broad access stair and triangular pediments. Official rounded width of 15 m includes a broader envelope than the 13.54 m architectural body; the model uses the narrower body and wider cornice. Published 17 and 17.1 m heights are rounded to 17 m. The mapped northern stair projection is retained. Capitals are simplified leaf-like profiles, not traced ornament; no lettering. Cityscape: not tested. Full 3D world: not tested.
